roadmap.summary: Finish all five chapters with both characters, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and never skip Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1.
roadmap.title: Play the story

roadmap.summary: Clear every side-character strand while it is offered: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, Cal, Moses and Yasmani, plus the Strangers & Freaks strands.
roadmap.title: Character quest lines

roadmap.summary: Races, drone races, shooting ranges, stunts, fishing, arcade games, sports and combat tricks — most of it while the map is still fresh.
roadmap.title: Activities and skills

roadmap.summary: Meditation spots, WAiNK scans, vehicles, card sets, challenges and full map exploration across Leonida.
roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration

roadmap.summary: After the credits, work the in-game 100% checklist: robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, then A Long Road and the platinum.
roadmap.title: 100% checklist and clean-up

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no extra task behind it, so treat it as a progress meter rather than a goal of its own: work the roadmap in order and it arrives after A Long Road.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Finish A Long Road last in practice, since 100% completion sweeps up most of the list.
Check the tracker here to find the stragglers.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for the opening mission, Gone Fishing, one of the first jobs of Chapter 1. Just play the story and it unlocks on its own; nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Start Chapter 1 and play through Gone Fishing.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1. It lands once you have started Chapter 2, after the first mission of the new chapter, so do not worry if it does not pop the instant the chapter-1 finale ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play every Chapter 1 mission to the end of the chapter.
Begin Chapter 2 and the trophy will follow.

trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 completion trophy. It is handed out as Chapter 3 opens, after the Welcome to Vice City mission, so keep playing into the next chapter and it will pop.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Finish all Chapter 2 missions.
Play the opening mission of Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 completion trophy. It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so the pop lags the chapter ending by a couple of missions.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Finish all Chapter 3 missions.
Play Ocean Beach and Another Life at the start of Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: The Chapter 4 completion trophy. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable: finish the chapter's missions and it is yours.
trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play every Chapter 4 mission through to the chapter's end.
The trophy pops as the chapter closes.

trophies.guide: One of the two gold trophies, for finishing the last story mission. Free roam keeps going after the credits, so everything else on this list can still be cleaned up afterwards — the story ending closes nothing.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Finish the final story mission.
Keep playing in free roam for the clean-up stages.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. Play the story in order and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Reach Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It is tied to the mission itself, so finishing that heist is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Complete the heist mission.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Child's Play in Chapter 4. Play the mission to the end and the trophy follows automatically.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Reach Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Headliners in Chapter 4. It unlocks when that mission is done, with nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Reach Headliners in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It is a straight mission completion trophy.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list and the second gold: reach 100% on the in-game checklist, which appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story. Everything done before the credits already counts, and nothing on the checklist itself is missable. Full credit is needed for robberies, the 8 bank vaults, the 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks; only a share of the rest is required, such as 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Finish the story to reveal the 100% checklist.
Clear every robbery, bank vault and gang operation.
Finish all Shooting Range golds, drone races and Target Decks.
Top up the partial counts: missions, scans, studies, meditations, challenges, stunts, WAiNK.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida, mixing the four types as you like: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to build the count, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Your count is under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and the map can show every Stunt Spot. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Turn on Stunt Spots on the map.
Fly under bridges for the quickest stunts.
Reach 250; push on to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress, Activities shows what is left, and most of these happen naturally while chasing other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Open Progress, Activities to see which types are untried.
Do one of each: fish, hunt, golf, shoot, pool, basketball, arcade, race, stunt.
The trophy pops on the ninth type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, so it pays to do them early. Each range has its own par times and target layouts, so replay a challenge until the gold threshold is beaten.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Visit all 12 shooting ranges.
Replay each challenge until gold; 42 golds in total.
Use the Focus gains for Gunslinger afterwards.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so it is worth clearing every race at a location while you are there instead of coming back.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Find the Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 spots.
Win one race per location.
Clear the remaining races at each spot for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Winning the same race twice does not count, so keep moving to new events rather than farming a favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Enter races across Leonida.
Win 20 distinct ones; replays of a won race add nothing.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, after which he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge. Because his strand starts in Chapter 1 and runs through texts and marked spots, do his quests as they appear rather than leaving them for the post-game.
trophies.missable_note: Cal's fishing strand opens in Chapter 1 (Feng Shui) and is driven by his texts; work it as it appears.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play Feng Shui in Chapter 1 to meet Cal.
Follow his texts to the marked fishing spot.
Complete his fishing quests and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick whichever game you are best at and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play an arcade game at home or on a cabinet.
Reach the end of the game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order — Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the last one awards the trophy. They stay available after the story, but only Lucia can do them, so switch to her for this strand.
trophies.missable_note: Lucia-only strand starting in Chapter 3; always play it as Lucia.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: As Lucia in Chapter 3, answer Andy's text and go to Belville.
Complete the five quests in order.
Finish Puff Puff Pass for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton, marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento, hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish the strand then — but start it in Chapter 1 while he is around. Track it under Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.missable_note: Kenton leaves after Chapter 1; start his shipwreck strand while he is available.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: In Chapter 1, meet Kenton in Key Lento.
Dive the 7 shipwreck sites and dig up the treasure with the metal detector.
Answer his later text as Jason to finish the strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth job, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story, so there is no rush once the strand is open.
trophies.missable_note: Opens only after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all five of Billy's jobs, ending with Hometown Heroes.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands were still being confirmed when the list went public, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list as you go. None of them are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story. Because stranger missions are only offered for a while, take each one when it appears.
trophies.missable_note: Stranger missions are only offered for a while; take each strand when it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Take stranger missions whenever they appear on the map.
Finish 8 qualifying strands; Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count.
Watch the trophy counter to confirm which strands qualify.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City, marked RK. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more.
trophies.missable_note: Needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3; the wish list only opens after that mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play the Key Cloner mission in Chapter 3.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK to find the 16 on Randy's list.
Deliver all 16 to his garage in west Vice City.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy. Play this strand as Jason.
trophies.missable_note: Jason-only strand after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: As Jason, play Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3.
Destroy the purple-marked synthetic labs around Vice City.
Finish Shut Down the Labs.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. This is the one trophy the guides flag as possibly missable: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it, so do not skip it.
trophies.missable_note: Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1 — do it the morning after Down to Earth.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony and meditate.
After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, meditate together at spots to count double.
Reach 18 spots; the final one needs both characters.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy was not confirmed yet when the list went public; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so clear them all.
trophies.missable_note: Jason-only hunting strand starting after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: As Jason after Coffee Break, answer Bret's text.
Start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Hunt the Target Deck animals and bring them back; clear all 15 decks.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is, so chase the sets you are nearest to finishing first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Open Progress, Collections to see each card set's progress.
Collect cards for your three nearest sets.
Complete any 3 sets.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel and the count builds up on its own; the 100% checklist wants 100 WAiNK scans too.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Open the WAiNK app while out in Leonida.
Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags.
Reach 100 scanned locations.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress, Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way — check the list late in the run and mop up the easy ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play normally; challenges tick off as you go.
Open Progress, Challenges to find unfinished easy ones.
Reach 50; push to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there. Your partner is not always available, so try it while you are playing a stretch with both characters together.
trophies.missable_note: Needs your partner beside you and a 4-star wanted level; partner availability varies by chapter, so do it while both characters are together.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner to your side.
Raise a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone completely.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth. Like Hot Together it needs your partner, so do it during a stretch when both characters are together.
trophies.missable_note: Needs your partner and three robberies in one wanted run; partner availability varies by chapter.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Bring your partner and stock up on armor, sticky bombs and healing.
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level.
Wait about 30 seconds; rob a fourth shop if it has not popped.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway on the road to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Open the WAiNK app near busy traffic.
Scan 100 different vehicles.
Keep scanning toward 200 for the 100% checklist.

counter.label: enemies taken down in one Combat Focus

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Fill your Focus before the fight.
Trigger Combat Focus while aiming at a group of gang thugs.
Take down 5 of them before Focus runs out.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge (planes parked out on the airfield do not count). Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Go to VCIA and reach a docked passenger jet at a gate bridge.
Steal the jet, back it out and take off.
Fly about 1 km clear of the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks are at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way in, so bring armor and a fast escape plan for the drive out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Reach Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County.
Steal a Rhino tank from the south end of the base.
Destroy enemies from the tank until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well. Do it while Yasmani's strand is active, since the Snap Gun comes from his jobs.
trophies.missable_note: Needs the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3; do it while his strand is active.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Open a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun, not a kick.
Find the safe code note, empty the safe unseen.

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Play That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4.
Follow a security van to its bank and enter the vault.
Hand a bag to your partner and escape; repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before that, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Box in an armored truck or rob a bank vault.
Blow the rear doors with a sticky bomb if it is a truck.
Escape the heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch. Work through the map region by region and the trophy pops once the last fog lifts.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Take a plane and fly over every dark patch of the map.
Check the map for remaining fog.
The trophy pops when the whole map is revealed.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress, Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so keep robbing past this trophy until every operation is done.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Find yellow illegal-operation icons on the map.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Track the count under Progress, Gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The description points to having a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. The exact steps were not confirmed yet when the trophy list went public, so treat this as a lead, not a recipe: head to the Ocean Beach waterfront, look for a bar or cocktail spot with a view, and order a drink there. Check the sources linked here for updates as players confirm the method.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Find a cocktail spot with a view of the water.
Order a cocktail there; method still being confirmed.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom — a nod to the classic showroom smash. The exact steps were not confirmed yet when the list went public, so treat this as a lead: drive a car into a showroom and out through its front window. Check the linked sources for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Find a vehicle showroom in Vice City.
Drive a car through the showroom and out its window.
Method still being confirmed; check the sources for updates.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back, so grab everything in one run if you can.
trophies.missable_note: Tied to the Hit Kingpin Bowling marker in Chapter 2 and a slow-respawning robbery; clear it in one visit.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Follow the Hit Kingpin Bowling marker in Port Gellhorn.
Take the watch, the shotgun and the safe in one visit.
Lose the police for the trophy to pop.

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia, Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map, Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home. Keep at it until both bars are full.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

steps: Find a fitness club under Map, Activities.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
